entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `name_pl` TEXT NOT NULL, `name_latin` TEXT NOT NULL, `name_common` TEXT NOT NULL, `edibility` TEXT NOT NULL, `season_start` INTEGER NOT NULL, `season_end` INTEGER NOT NULL, `habitat` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `thumbnail_asset` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`name_pl` TEXT NOT NULL, `name_latin` TEXT NOT NULL, `name_common` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`species`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_species_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `species` BEGIN DELETE FROM `species_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_species_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `species` BEGIN DELETE FROM `species_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_species_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `species` BEGIN INSERT INTO `species_fts`(`docid`, `name_pl`, `name_latin`, `name_common`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`name_pl`, NEW.`name_latin`, NEW.`name_common`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_species_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `species` BEGIN INSERT INTO `species_fts`(`docid`, `name_pl`, `name_latin`, `name_common`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`name_pl`, NEW.`name_latin`, NEW.`name_common`); END
